config firewall policy
    edit 220064
        set name "netops-firewall-policies-published"
        set uuid 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004
        set srcintf "dmz"
        set dstintf "wan2"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "netops-firewall-policies-src"
        set dstaddr "netops-firewall-policies-dst"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "HTTPS"
        set utm-status enable
        set ssl-ssh-profile "certificate-inspection"
        set webfilter-profile "default"
        set logtraffic all
        set nat enable
    next
end
